name: FS.COM Limited
summary: FS.COM Ltd. sells optical communication products worldwide and operates as a trading and investment holding company. It was founded in 2009 by Wei Xiang and is headquartered in Shenzhen. Products include networking hardware, operating systems for scalable networking gear and cloud-based network management platforms. Through an online, platform-centered model it serves needs from computing and data centers to enterprise networks and telecom.
